confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence: they rest on blog and aggregator ranges (Portugalist, GetWhereNext, Expatistan, Lisbon Tourism-style guides) that partly conflict, and the cheap-end figures differ by about 2x. Accommodation anchors are low confidence: the sources are undated, mix currencies and areas, and are not July 2026 listing averages, so the July high-season uplift is an estimate. Cocktail and wine_glass are informed by local price relationships: the cocktail anchor is based on an undated club-level average, and the wine glass anchor is based on Lisbon bar glass prices (around 4-5 EUR) and sits close to the beer anchor, as is typical locally. The FX observation (0.6955 USD per AUD, 15 Oct 2026) was reported in a search summary attributed to the RBA's published figures; I did not independently read the RBA table, and the 16 Oct figure from a third-party site was not used. EUR-denominated prices were converted at an approximate mid-2026 EUR/USD rate, which was not separately verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Lisbon-specific sources were cross-checked against the broader Western European tourist-city pattern, with July high-season pricing applied to accommodation.
